item.title: WICKED: FOR GOOD's CinemaScore Revealed As Sequel's Writer Teases A Huge Deleted Scene - SPOILERS

item.title: J.K. Rowling Inspects HARRY POTTER Set While HBO Reveals Plans To Film Season 2 Quickly
item.description: Series creator J.K. Rowling recently visited the set of HBO’s Harry Potter adaptation, while chairman and CEO Casey Bloys is already looking ahead to plans for a second season.

item.title: "Bring It On...": Benedict Cumberbatch Responds To DOCTOR STRANGE 3 Rumors About Creative Control, Sam Mendes
item.description: Following reports that Benedict Cumberbatch is looking for a greater level of creative control with Doctor Strange 3, the actor has been asked about those rumours and claims he wants Sam Mendes to direct.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: There's A Surprisingly Easy Way To Find Out Whether Those "Leaked" Images Are Real Or Fake
item.description: As fake images from Avengers: Doomsday continue to flood social media, we have an explanation for where they're coming from and, more importantly, how to identify when they're real or (more likely) not.
